subject_session: sub-A3716 / ses-201015b (example); pipeline repeated across 19 sessions/19 mice

headline_stat.name: median ring score REM (data vs shuffle)

stated_limitation: Because the recordings are from postsubiculum, this shows that the ring is expressed there; it does not localise where in the head-direction circuit it is generated.

justification.dataset: DANDI 000939 is a large Peyrache-lab postsubiculum HD-cell dataset with alternating foraging and home-cage sleep, the canonical preparation for demonstrating an internally maintained ring attractor during sleep.
justification.handling: Real NWB files are streamed from S3 with remfile, HD cells selected via the dataset flag plus explicit rate/tuning-strength/split-half-stability criteria, and sleep epochs restricted to home-cage with REM/NREM scoring.
justification.analysis: Ring geometry, persistent-homology H1, Bayesian and split-half decoding, angular velocity, pairwise correlation and a cross-validated cyclic-B-spline Poisson GLM are all applied with correct circular statistics and matched per-cell circular-shift nulls.
justification.correctness: The reported medians match the committed cross_session_metrics.csv exactly, are internally consistent with the figures, and rest on 19 sessions with proper shuffle controls.
justification.figures: Figures show the annulus clearly in every state with the shuffle collapsing it, axes and sample sizes labeled, and example GLM units chosen honestly rather than to flatter.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate, weaker NREM measures are flagged with mechanistic reasons, cell-count dependence is shown, and the postsubiculum localization limit is stated explicitly.
